dev.heading: Devices
dev.empty: No devices yet — add one above or scan your subnet.
th.name: Name
badge.custom_hint: Not an official Tasmota release (build name is not release-…). Never auto-updated, so the custom build is not overwritten.
edit.title: Edit device
edit.name: Name
edit.auto_name_hint: When enabled, the name is overwritten from the device on every backup/refresh. Disable it to keep a custom name permanently.
confirm.update: Update firmware of {name}? A backup is taken first.
confirm.update_custom: WARNING: {name} runs custom firmware ({version}). An update flashes the image from the device OtaUrl and may replace the custom build with official firmware. Continue anyway? A backup is taken first.
confirm.delete: Delete {name} and all of its backups?
backups.title: Backups
settings.fw_hint: Global master switch. Even when ON, only devices with their own "Auto-update" toggle enabled will update. A fresh backup is always taken first.
settings.mqtt_hint: Optional. Finds Tasmota devices via the MQTT broker (sends STATUS to the group topic). The backup itself still runs over HTTP.
events.heading: Event log
events.retention_hint: Old entries are pruned automatically after the retention period configured in the settings.
settings.online_hint: How often all devices are checked for reachability. 0 disables the check (status is then only updated during backups).
settings.notify_hint: On problems (failed backup, aborted or stuck update, device offline) a message is sent to this address. Leave empty for event log only.
settings.notify_test_hint: Saves first, then immediately sends a probe message.
tz.drift_hint: The device clock differs from the configured time zone ({tz}) — usually a fixed offset without DST switching.
tz.fixed_hint: The device uses a fixed UTC offset instead of DST rules. The clock happens to be right today, but will be an hour off after the next changeover.
edit.tz_hint: Tasmota does not know zone names. Without DST rules (Timezone 99) the device clock is an hour off for half the year.
edit.tz_unknown: not read yet — device has not been reachable
